visual.spotlight: dusky violet field warming to a narrow peach horizon
visual.motion: harp-like downward sweeps, gentle upward plucks, complete quiet exit
visual.reveal: performance marks begin offstage; board eases fully into view after the opening phrase
visual.transitions: motion-led section changes with percussion transformation; board fully clears below frame before the final beat
visual.particles: tone notes and drum-specific glyphs remain fully opaque, never clear at transitions, fall under gravity, and are removed only below frame
